reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Accelerating HIV and AIDS, Tuberculosis Prevention, Treatment, Care and Support and building resilient and sustainable systems for health in The Gambia - Gambia (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Gambia, TB/HIV, The National AIDS Secretariat of the Republic of The Gambia (NAS)This program has the following goals: To accelerate the achievement of the 95-95-95 targets in line with our national, regional, and global commitments.. To enhance universal access to quality and responsive patient centered TB services towards ending the TB epidemic in the Gambia. The objectives of this program are: Increase the proportion of PLHIV who know their status from 56% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Increase the proportion of PLHIV on treatment from 65% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Increase the proportion of PLHIV on treatment who are virally supressed from 26% in 2022 to 95% by 2026;. Ensure Zero stigma and discrimination and enhance the human rights of PLHIV; and. Facilitate a Sustainable National Response to HIV and AIDS. To increase the TB treatment coverage from 64% in 2022 to 75% by 2026. To increase the treatment success rate of all forms of TB from 84% in 2021 to 90% by 2026. To increase the proportion of children under 15 years among all forms of TB notified with TB from the current 7% (2022) to 10% by 2026. To scale up universal access to integrated services for all patients with TB and HIV co-infection and patients with comorbidities. To scale up access of eligible childhood contacts and PLHIV to TB preventive Treatment (TPT). To increase the treatment success rate of patients with RR/MDR TB from 89% (2021) to 90% by 2026

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GMB-C-NASP03
Percentage of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HIV-exposed infants receiving a virological test for HIV within 2 months of birth
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Percentage of people living with HIV currently enrolled on antiretroviral therapy who started TB preventive treatment (TPT) during the reporting period
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of children (under 15) on ART among all children living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of adults (15 and above) on ART among all adults living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy
Number of people with confirmed RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of people living with HIV newly initiated on ART who were screened for TB
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
